label: microbial community cultivation setup
definition: A hardware/instrumentation and operating-mode configuration used to grow or sustain a microbial community.

label: cultivation mode
definition: The operating mode or approach used to cultivate a microbial community.

label: cultivation system
definition: The instrumentation or vessel system used to grow a microbial community.

label: batch culture
definition: A cultivation-mode value indicating a closed culture with no nutrient addition or removal after inoculation.

label: fed-batch culture
definition: A cultivation-mode value indicating cultivation in which nutrients are fed during the run with no removal of culture broth.

label: continuous culture
definition: A cultivation-mode value indicating cultivation in which fresh medium is added and culture is withdrawn continuously, typically at steady state.

label: semi-continuous culture
definition: A cultivation-mode value indicating cultivation with periodic partial harvest and replacement of medium.

label: chemostat culture
definition: A cultivation-mode value indicating a continuous culture held at steady state by a fixed dilution rate and a growth-limiting nutrient.

label: turbidostat culture
definition: A cultivation-mode value indicating a continuous culture controlled to hold constant turbidity or cell density.

label: perfusion culture
definition: A cultivation-mode value indicating continuous medium exchange with biomass retention.

label: sequencing batch culture
definition: A cultivation-mode value indicating repeated fill, react, settle, and draw cycles in a single vessel.

label: retentostat culture
definition: A cultivation-mode value indicating a continuous culture with complete biomass retention, approaching near-zero growth rate.

label: other cultivation mode
definition: A cultivation-mode value indicating a mode not covered by the enumerated values.

label: stirred-tank bioreactor
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a mechanically stirred tank reactor (CSTR-type).

label: photobioreactor
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a light-driven reactor for cultivating phototrophic organisms.

label: microbial fuel cell
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a bioelectrochemical system that generates electric current from microbial metabolism.

label: bioelectrochemical system
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating an electrode-coupled reactor broader than a microbial fuel cell (e.g. microbial electrolysis or electrosynthesis cells).

label: chemostat vessel
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a vessel configured for chemostat (dilution-rate-controlled) continuous culture.

label: membrane bioreactor
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a reactor coupling cultivation with a membrane for biomass/liquid separation.

label: serum bottle
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a sealed serum bottle, commonly used for anaerobic cultivation.

label: culture flask
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating an Erlenmeyer or shake flask used for cultivation.

label: gas-lift reactor
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a pneumatically mixed reactor (airlift / gas-lift).

label: packed-bed reactor
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a reactor with a fixed packed support matrix for biofilm growth.

label: microfluidic cultivation device
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a microfluidic cultivation chip or device.

label: hollow-fiber reactor
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a hollow-fiber membrane cultivation system.

label: other cultivation system
definition: A cultivation-system value indicating a system not covered by the enumerated values.
